summary: Indian equities opened firmly higher after the holiday, recovering part of Monday's fall, while broader markets lagged the frontline gains with midcaps barely up and smallcaps flat.

detail.leaders: Frontline indices; Sensex up nearly 590 pts, Hindustan Zinc up 4%
detail.laggards: Bajaj Finance down ~2.7% after Q2; small caps flat
detail.tone: The gap-up flagged pre-open has held in early trade, reversing part of Monday's 1.1% fall, though broader markets are not joining in yet.
